macros.name: Crochet
macros.doc: The output consists of the two arguments separated by a comma and enclosed in a pair of adjustable-size angular-parenthesys, with the optional argument placed as a subscript.

macros.name: D
macros.doc: The command \D is defined to print a calligraphic “D” in math-mode, followed by the output of \@DefaultSet.

macros.name: DefaultSet
macros.doc: The command \DefaultSet makes \@DefaultSet to print the given argument enclosed in brackets.

macros.name: H
macros.doc: The \H command is used to generate the symbol of sobolev spaces.

macros.name: HAccent
macros.doc: The effect of “\H” (which is a type of accent) can now be achieved by the command “\HAccent”, whilst the job of “\L” (i.e. print an “L” with a superimposed bar) is now done by the command “\Lbar”.

macros.name: Hdiv
macros.doc: The \Hdiv command is used to generate the sobolev space called “H div”.

macros.name: L
macros.doc: The \L command is used to generate the symbol of Lebesguemeasurable functions.

macros.name: NoDefaultSet
macros.doc: The command \NoDefaultSet deletes the content of the two macros \@DefaultSet and \@DefaultSet@Div, so that the first prints nothing, whilst the second only prints “(div)”.

macros.name: Norm
macros.doc: The command \Norm prints its argument surrounded by a double-pipe delimiter of adjustable size.

macros.name: Scalar
macros.doc: The output consists of the two arguments separated by a comma and enclosed in a pair of adjustable-size brackets, with the optional argument placed as a subscript.

macros.name: W
macros.doc: The command \W is defined to print a “W” in math-mode with its two arguments as a superscript (separated by a comma) and followed by the output of \@DefaultSet.
